title: control.deploy_command payload v1
description: Instructs an Agent to deploy a release of an application using the adapter appropriate to its OS. Contract only in Phase 1 — not yet sent or acted on.

location.description: Repo URL or existing folder path.

ref.description: Git ref, or a release label for a folder source.

ports.description: Ports allocated by the Control Plane for each instance.

zero_downtime.description: Roll instances one at a time behind the gateway rather than stopping all at once.
